title: Types of Inference: Serverless vs. Real-Time vs. Asynchronous

cues.en: Hello and welcome back.
Today we're talking about types of inference in SageMaker.
cues.zh: 今天談 SageMaker 推論類型。

cues.en: Now I'm going to start by looking at this website over here, which is the SageMaker Model Deployment page.
cues.zh: 先看這個網站，SageMaker Model Deployment 頁面。

cues.en: And if you scroll down a bit further, you'll see the types of inference.
There's a real-time inference, there's serverless inference, there's asynchronous inference, and there's batch transform.
So you need to know all four of these for the exam and their details.
cues.zh: 考試要知道四種及細節。

cues.en: And very likely, you will get a question about this on the exam.
So let's have a look in more depth.
So the types of inference, we're gonna have a table here, and this will be the easiest way to remember.
The first type of inference is real-time inference.
Here you've got a payload limit, meaning the maximum amount of data, whether it's image or text, or a certain file that you can send for inference is six megabytes.
cues.zh: Payload 上限，也就是影像、文字或檔案等送入推論的資料量，為 6 MB。

cues.en: It takes about 60 seconds to post, well, the maximum time.
So remember, this is the limit.
You are limited to this time of processing.
Cannot process for longer than that.
It's a hard limit of 60 seconds processing time allowed.
cues.zh: 允許最多 60 秒，是硬限制。

cues.en: And the latency, it's real time.
So it will start processing.
You'll start working on it right away as soon as you get, you send it over there.
cues.zh: 資料一送過去，就立即運作。

cues.en: Next, we've got serverless inference.
Here, the payload limit is the same, six megabyte, and the processing time limit, again, that you cannot go over, or the processing of your model cannot go over, is 60 seconds.
cues.zh: 同樣 6 MB，上限 60 秒，模型處理不可超過。

cues.en: Latency is very similar to real time, but there can be possible delays due to a cold start.
cues.zh: 延遲接近即時，但冷啟動可能延後。

cues.en: So the benefit of serverless inference, you don't have to manage the infrastructure.
cues.zh: 好處是不必管理基礎設施。

cues.en: It's going to basically just pop up when you need it as needed, but sometimes it can be a cold start, meaning that it's not running, so there'll be a few seconds delay
cues.zh: 需要時才啟動，但如果沒在運作，可能冷啟動而延遲數秒，

cues.en: because it needs to get running.
So here, when would you use this?
You would use this for things that are near real time but don't have to be happening right away, such as a chatbot, for example.
cues.zh: 接近即時，但不用立刻，例如聊天機器人。

cues.en: It doesn't matter if your customer has to wait one or two extra seconds.
cues.zh: 顧客多等一兩秒沒關係。

cues.en: Next one is asynchronous inference, and here, the payload limit is much higher.
cues.zh: 非同步推論，資料量上限高很多。

cues.en: It's one gigabytes.
The proceeding time is also higher.
It's a maximum of one hour, and it's latency is near real time, meaning how quickly this job will get started.
cues.zh: 最多一小時，作業開始的延遲接近即時。

cues.en: And you would use this for things like video processing or document analysis, things that don't have to happen right away.
cues.zh: 適合影片處理、文件分析，不需立即完成。

cues.en: And finally, there's batch transform.
So I put it separately because it's kind of a separate thing.
The payload limit is a hundred megabytes.
Processing time is up to one hour, and this one is not real time.
cues.zh: 處理最多一小時，這不是即時。

cues.en: So basically, you set it up and then it will happen when it happens.
So this would be something for analyzing historical trends in data and things like that.
cues.zh: 適合分析歷史資料趨勢等等。

cues.en: So there we go.
That's the four main types of inference you need to know.
A sample question on exam could be you're given the payload.
So for example, you know that the payload is one gigabyte and needs to be processed within one hour, which type of inference is the correct type of inference.
cues.zh: 例如 1 GB，需一小時內處理，該用哪種？

cues.en: And from this table, you can see right away it's asynchronous inference.
cues.zh: 由表格直接知道非同步。

cues.en: So you do need to know the details of each type of inference from this table.
Here's a quick summary of what we discussed with the examples that were mentioned, and I look forward to seeing you back here next time.
cues.zh: 這裡快速整理與例子，期待下次見。

cues.en: Until then, enjoy the cloud.
cues.zh: 在那之前，享受雲端的樂趣吧。
